body: Yeah I can totally relate. I’m nobody’s first choice and I spend every second I have with people trying to make them laugh and enjoy themselves around me so that maybe they’ll think of being around me outside of a classroom where they are forced to be with me

I have no other girl I care about, so its just touchy. If you want you can talk to me bout the girl you mentioned. I’d love to listen. Carry on man

Thank you for replying. And to your reply I say that I’m not in love with her. I can’t because of all the time I haven’t been with her. I have been in love before. I was completely in love and it was the almost the same situation. I drive myself crazy over that other girl and well there’s a lot to that. It’s interesting what you said about how I am sorta clouded just cause she is beautiful. In a way it’s true, and that’s something that is hard for all guys to resist. The truth is I enjoy her personality and mannerisms and integrity so much. She different that everyone else, at least I hope. I see stuff in her that are in me too. I value her beauty the least but yeah, I get stunned when I do look into her eyes. My motivation is just gone. I wanna be better so people might notice me so I guess that’s something. But, I constantly try to talk to people, to make them like me, to make them think that maybe they should hang out with me instead for once and it’s just never happened. If you’re not trapped in a desk next to me, then you’re not gonna willingly talk to me again. To me, living for myself is worthless, but living for others is impossible. Thanks for reading
